name: PEG-20 Cocamide MEA
description: PEG-20 Cocamide MEA (CAS 68425-44-5 ), also known commercially as PEG-2 Cocamide, is an ethoxylated coconut-derived amide used across personal care and industrial cleaning formulations. It functions primarily as a nonionic surfactant, delivering emulsification and foam enhancement. This versatile chemical provides mild cleansing performance in aqueous systems. In shampoos, body washes, and liquid soaps, it boosts foam volume and stabilizes lather while contributing mild moisturizing properties to the finished product. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations rely on it to emulsify oils and greases, improving soil removal in hard surface cleaners and degreasers. It is highly effective at breaking down complex organic residues in commercial settings. Textile processing operations use it as an emulsifier and wetting agent during scouring and dyeing stages, where consistent fiber penetration is critical. This ensures that dyes and treatments are applied evenly across various fabric types. In leather and paper processing, it supports dispersion of treatment agents and improves substrate uptake of finishing compounds. This leads to higher quality outputs and more efficient use of chemical additives during the manufacturing cycle. PEG-20 Cocamide MEA is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, depending on ethoxylation degree and ambient temperature. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with cosmetic-grade material meeting high purity standards. The material is suitable for personal care formulations requiring stable shelf lives. Packaging options generally include drums and IBCs for bulk industrial supply, ensuring safe transport and storage for large-scale manufacturing facilities.
